# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a single-file portrait mobile browser game called **Hawkins Rift Riders**. It is mechanically a first-person raycaster maze: left analog stick moves/strafe, right touch drag rotates, random 24x24 maze, 50 collectibles, one key, six chasing monsters, wall collision, close pickup checks, monster contact death, restart. The presentation is a Stranger-Things-inspired sci-fi horror adventure with bike-riding teens, small-town skyline, VHS/synth dread, glowing portal veins, signal-tape collectibles, a gate cipher, friendship HUD, and shadow-monster suspense. Use browser-native Canvas/CSS/JS and preserve mobile actionability.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a single-file mobile-first first-person raycaster. The player starts from an overlay, enters a randomly generated 24x24 maze, moves with a left touch joystick, rotates view by dragging the right side, collects 50 resources, can pick up one key, and loses when any of six monsters contacts the player. Wall collision blocks movement; resource/key pickup and monster contact use close-range distance checks.

## Protected mechanics
- 320x568 internal raycaster resolution and portrait-first presentation.
- 24x24 maze with border walls and random internal blockers.
- 50 collectible resources, one key, six monsters.
- Left joystick forward/strafe and right-side drag rotation.
- Movement speed, rotation scale, pickup threshold, monster chase and death semantics.
- Start, game-over, restart, HUD score/key state, and final score semantics.

## Remix target
Stranger Things sci-fi horror adventure with small-town mystery, 80s nostalgia, supernatural portals, bike-riding teens, synth dread, friendship-driven quests, shadow-monster suspense, and portrait mobile-first controls. The rebuilt game is **Hawkins Rift Riders**, where a bike-riding teen party recovers signal tapes and a gate cipher while shadow monsters stalk a rift-corrupted small town.

## Safe transformation surfaces
HUD words, start/game-over copy, canvas colors, wall motif rendering, sprite silhouettes, feedback overlays, title/typography, procedural background, audio tone generation, and mobile UI styling.
